They shall call his name Emmanuel... God with us. Mt. 1:23 Thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people. 1:21 He... stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us. 2 Cor. 1:21; 1 Jn. 2:27 Christ is all, and in all. Col. 3:11
